general_information.Description: The main objective of the course is to help students develop the academic language and academic skills especially Listening and Speaking skills. Besides, the course aims at providing students with strategies necessary to achieve proficiency in English. 1. Developing skills: 1.1 Listening skills: Prediction, Listening for signpost words, Classification, Understanding illustration: map, visual information, Note taking, Listening for paraphrase, etc. 1.2 Speaking skills: Giving factual information, Expressing opinions /attitudes /preferences / reasons/feelings, Describing, Comparing and contrasting, Speculation, etc. 2. Developing language: Increase academic vocabulary, including collocations, and sentence structures through the topics in academic context. 3. Dealing with tests/exams: provide students with different kinds of listening and speaking tasks simulating exams for practice.
general_information.StudentTasks: Regularly attend class-meeting hours and complete assignments and homeworks For BBA students: must attend at least 80% of the total course time in order to be admitted to the final exam

assessments.Question Type: Form completion / sentence completion /multiple choices /matching /short answer …
assessments.Knowledge and Skill: 1-2 records Students answer various questions covering listening skills learnt in the respective units.
assessments.Grading Guide: In classroom, supervised by class instructor/s
assessments.Note: The tests must be designed based on the skills covered in the tested units. Students are allowed to listen twice

assessments.Question Type: Independent mini-talk and interview with instructor
assessments.No Question: 1 for individual mini-talk, varies for interview
assessments.Knowledge and Skill: Students give a mini-talk and answer various questions covering topics learnt in the respective units. Progress tests 1-3 focus on mini-talk, progress tests 4-5 focus on interview.
assessments.Grading Guide: In classroom, students interviewed by class instructor/s
assessments.Note: The tests must be designed based on the topics and skills covered in the tested units. Depending on the class size, several teachers may be involved to interview students within the time limit.

assessments.Question Type: Listening: 04 recordings Students answer various questions covering listening skills learnt in 10 units.
assessments.Note: Listening: Students are allowed to listen twice

assessments.Question Type: Speaking: 03 parts 1. Part 1: Speak about yourself / familiar topics 2. Part 2: A talk about a topic in the course 3. Part 3: Discussion
assessments.Grading Guide: Speaking: in exam room, face to face with examiners
assessments.Note: Speaking: Task 1 dealing with self-introduction. Therefore, it is assumed that students can handle it at this level without class instruction during the course.
